scope: Descriptive accounting of every completed agent12 round: six native requests per case and arm, 72 per arm. No partial historical study is read; no new qualification, hypothesis test or source choice is made.

reference_method.rule: Each request excludes its final cycle conservatively, then excludes earlier cycles with fewer than verify_rows-1 proposals. Profiles describe each drafter's encountered prefixes, not matched prefixes.

medium_cancel.measured: Across six runs per arm, emitted tokens per recorded cycle change by 1.56%; explicit decode GPU milliseconds per cycle change by 8.68%. Pooled wall decode throughput changes by -6.52%.
medium_cancel.inference: Emitted work per cycle does not offset the higher GPU cost per cycle, consistent with the observed regression.

medium_router.measured: Across six runs per arm, emitted tokens per recorded cycle change by 29.55%; explicit decode GPU milliseconds per cycle change by 5.79%. Pooled wall decode throughput changes by 22.48%.
medium_router.inference: The increase in emitted work per cycle exceeds the higher GPU cost per cycle, consistent with the observed gain.

short_rust.measured: Across six runs per arm, emitted tokens per recorded cycle change by -2.90%; explicit decode GPU milliseconds per cycle change by 6.71%. Pooled wall decode throughput changes by -8.98%.
short_rust.inference: Emitted work per cycle does not offset the higher GPU cost per cycle, consistent with the observed regression.

short_sql.measured: Across six runs per arm, emitted tokens per recorded cycle change by 11.11%; explicit decode GPU milliseconds per cycle change by 6.65%. Pooled wall decode throughput changes by 4.22%.
short_sql.inference: The increase in emitted work per cycle exceeds the higher GPU cost per cycle, consistent with the observed gain.

timing_semantics.gpu: Use the explicit decode_gpu_ms field only: study_driver_v2.mm records the delta of totalDecodeGpuSeconds, separately from prefill_gpu_ms. No wall-clock TTFT is subtracted from GPU time.
timing_semantics.wall: Registered decode wall is wall_ms minus ttft_ms and counts returned tokens minus one. Dividing that interval by all recorded cycles is only an amortized descriptor: TTFT already excludes an initial interval, so this is not a measured single-cycle latency.
timing_semantics.attribution: Reported decode GPU time bundles pipeline work; these traces do not separate draft generation, target verification, attention, projections or cache work. Wider verification and higher measured cycle cost are consistent, but their causal phase shares cannot be inferred.

censoring: All-cycle sums retain terminal and partial cycles. Eligible profiles exclude each request's final cycle even when full-width, plus earlier partial-width cycles. Output-cap requests and terminal extra emissions are recorded separately. A fraction accepted out of 15 proposals is not directly the same quality measure as a fraction out of seven; eligible prefixes are not matched between drafters.
